grades.lower_bound_mechanism: rank-pairing multigraph on Liu's intervals; edge count < vertices forces a tree component, bipartition gives distinct subsets with |sum difference| <= D, so D >= Gamma = delta for the 1:2:4:...:2^n division
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: subset-sum pigeonhole (2^{n+1} sums in [0,1]) gives gap <= 1/(2^{n+1}-1), realized by overlay/common-refinement construction using at most q-1 = n cuts, plus bisection when q <= n
grades.notes: All three mechanisms written out for general n: alternating-sum drafting lemma proved by induction with explicit cancellation; exact refinement lemma (D_min = minimal subset-sum gap) with tree-component argument for the lower half and overlay construction with cut accounting for the upper half; correct closed form boxed.
